about:
Palmetto Sheet Metal operates from Dalzell, South Carolina, as a locally owned and operated fabrication shop. The company specializes in sheet metal products for roofing, metal buildings, and custom projects, combining traditional workmanship with modern CNC equipment to deliver precision-crafted metal solutions.

The shop produces roofing and metal building trim, accessories, commemorative plaques, displays, and custom one-off pieces using CNC precision cutting and forming. It handles both large-scale production runs and small custom jobs, serving residential, commercial, and industrial clients with a focus on accuracy and efficiency.

Customers span food service, HVAC, construction, and DIY markets, with contractors, builders, and homeowners among the typical buyers. The company also fabricates custom components for commemorative and personal projects, extending its reach beyond traditional construction applications.

Palmetto Sheet Metal emphasizes reliable quality, fair pricing, and fast turnaround, backed by a responsive team and broad material selection. Its mission centers on delivering precision-crafted metal solutions with honest service and a commitment to customer success.
